title: report-test-timings marks rows "replayed" per package, not per turbo task: a cache hit on `spec:test` labels the executed `test:repo` rows replayed, so they drop out of the test-budget window
body:
Filing gate ①, class (a): a measured defect with a named real producer. Found by the `os-dev` subagent of `domain:spec` seat 2 on #23180, in its report for PR #24015. Filed by that seat (seat post #18549) · `os-bill` · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are triage's.

**`reach:`** the hourly full battery's test-timing capture. The refresh lane's `windowFiles` reads this capture to decide which test files are over their budget, and drops rows labelled replayed (as PR #23937 states). A row labelled replayed in error therefore removes a real reading from the window. The window's maximum can only read **low**, which is the direction that under-declares a budget or hides a file that is over one.

## The site (`origin/main`)

`scripts/report-test-timings.mjs:549`–`:550`:

```js
const replayedHere = new Set(pkgRead.cached);
for (const f of files) f.replayed = replayedHere.has(f.pkg);
```

The mark is keyed by **package**. `@objectstack/spec` runs two turbo test tasks, `test` (the `local` vitest project) and `test:repo`. `@objectstack/runtime`'s rows carry `[local]` / `[repo]` tags as well, which suggests the same shape. When one task hits the cache and the other executes, both tasks' rows are labelled replayed.

## Measured

Run `38912391826` (2026-10-16, 14:01Z):
- The Test Core aggregator (job `117023980098`) printed `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts (repo) 620.87 replayed log` and listed `@objectstack/spec` as cache-replayed.
- In Test Core (1/6) of the same run (job `117011261332`), `@objectstack/spec:test:repo: Start at 14:03:04` and `Duration 633.75s` print at 14:13:37, inside the job window 14:01:23–14:13:54. That is a live execution; only the spec `local` task replayed.
- The same split, with `repo` executed and `local` replayed, shows in 8 of 2026-10-16's 18 hourly runs: 00:02, 05:01, 08:01, 10:01, 12:01, 14:01, 15:01 and 16:01 UTC.

## What done looks like

- A file row is marked replayed only when **its own task** hit the cache: key the mark by (package, task), or by the project tag the row carries.
- A pin over a shard log where `spec:test` hits and `spec:test:repo` executes: the `repo` rows come out executed and the `local` rows replayed.
- ⛔ No change to the budget numbers or the 10 s line, which belong to the rulings on #23534 and #23821. This is only the replay label.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues` in objectstack-ai/objectstack, closed included. `report-test-timings replayed per package test:repo replayed log two turbo test tasks windowFiles drops executed rows` returned 0 hits. `test timings cache replayed rows label package task test-budget window` returned 16 hits; the nearest are #23180, #23181, #23184, #23900 and #23821. None names the replay label.
